summary: Replay the already dual-OS-verified Issue #70 interpreter-resolution fix on top of the Job-lifecycle main without dropping the new tests. Windows PATHEXT commands that already carry an extension resolve correctly, path candidates must be ordinary files, and POSIX candidates must be executable.

pointers: scripts.test retains rlm-job-lifecycle and adds rlm-python-resolution

steps: PR #96 had already passed the merged #72 Windows+Ubuntu gate, but #97 later changed the same package test-command line while fixing M12 Jobs.

Created a fresh branch from main d6ac36f instead of force-merging the conflict. A guarded one-shot replay copied the exact verified settings/test files from #96 and patched only the current package test anchor, preserving rlm-job-lifecycle.test.ts.
The replay workflow deleted itself after commit; final PR CI will re-run both OS families with both regression files in one command.

evidence.note: The exact Issue #70 production/test logic passed memory, Windows and Ubuntu before the later package-line conflict.
Copied only the verified Issue #70 files, preserved the current Job test command, committed, and removed the temporary workflow.
Triggered after opening the v3 PR and must pass before merge.

limitations: Shell aliases remain intentionally unsupported because the runtime directly spawns a command rather than invoking an interactive shell.
